notes: EBIT definition: set equal to GAAP income from operations (operating income) from the consolidated income statement. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))

D&A definition: set equal to cash flow line 'Depreciation and amortization' (includes amortization components included in that cash flow line). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))

Capex definition: set equal to cash flow line 'Purchases of property and equipment' (positive absolute value). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))

NWC construction (sign convention matters): NWC = (Accounts receivable + Inventories + Other current assets) − (Accounts payable + Accrued liabilities + Deferred revenue), excluding cash/cash equivalents and excluding investments. Negative NWC indicates deferred revenue and payables exceed operating current assets at year-end. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))

Forecast drivers (base case) are held as % of sales for D&A, capex, and NWC; EBIT margin and revenue growth follow a modest normalization profile consistent with FY26 revenue guide (0% to 4%). ([f5.com](https://www.f5.com/ko_kr/company/news/press-releases/earnings-fy25-q4))

Tax rate: base-case tax_rate set to 0.17 as a conservative normalized assumption given historical effective tax rate variability; FY25 effective tax rate was notably lower than FY24/FY23. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))
WACC is a modeling input (0.09) not explicitly disclosed in sources pulled in this run; adjust as needed to your firm’s capital market methodology.

NOL balance: estimated as federal ($122.9M) + state ($260.8M) + foreign ($53.2M) carryforwards disclosed in FY25 tax note; these are 'approximately' amounts. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))

NOL utilization percent (nol_utilization_pct) is not disclosed explicitly in the retrieved excerpts; set to null to avoid inventing utilization timing/limits. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))

Comp multiples: EV/NTM revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA were not consistently captured from accessible sources in this run, so those fields are null for most peers; only forward P/E for FTNT was captured. (Triangulation only.)

catalysts: Evidence of sustained 2H26 normalization in sales cycles following the security incident and improved order conversion. ([f5.com](https://www.f5.com/ko_kr/company/news/press-releases/earnings-fy25-q4))

Systems and software momentum (FY25 systems growth was highlighted by management) translating into durable subscription renewals and upsell. ([f5.com](https://www.f5.com/ko_kr/company/news/press-releases/earnings-fy25-q4))
Any update to FY26 guidance range as customer remediation activity stabilizes.
company_overview: F5 provides application delivery and security solutions used to deploy, operate, secure, optimize, and govern every application and API across on-premises, cloud, or edge environments.
The company reports revenue primarily as products and services, with a meaningful mix of services alongside systems and software offerings.
Operations are managed on a consolidated basis with significant international exposure across Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
current_context: FY25 results: revenue of $3.1B (+10% YoY) with FY25 operating income of $766M (24.8% operating margin). ([f5.com](https://www.f5.com/ko_kr/company/news/press-releases/earnings-fy25-q4))

FY26 outlook: management guided total revenue growth of 0% to 4%, with near-term disruption expected to be more pronounced in 1H26, normalizing in 2H26; FY26 non-GAAP operating margin guided at 33.5% to 34.5%. ([f5.com](https://www.f5.com/ko_kr/company/news/press-releases/earnings-fy25-q4))
investment_highlights: Base-case top-line growth reflects management’s FY26 0% to 4% guide and a gradual re-acceleration to modest mid-single-digit growth thereafter. ([f5.com](https://www.f5.com/ko_kr/company/news/press-releases/earnings-fy25-q4))

Base-case EBIT margin assumes slight normalization versus FY25, holding ~24.0% to 24.2% over the forecast horizon rather than extrapolating recent peaks. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))

Capital intensity is modeled at ~1.35% of sales, consistent with recent capex levels in the cash flow statement. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))

Working capital is modeled as structurally negative (high deferred revenue), supported by historical NWC levels calculated from balance sheet operating current assets and liabilities. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))
key_risks: Longer-than-expected disruption to sales cycles or delayed conversion could push growth below the base case. ([f5.com](https://www.f5.com/ko_kr/company/news/press-releases/earnings-fy25-q4))
Operating margin may face pressure from reinvestment needs, restructuring costs, or mix shift between products and services.
Working capital could move less negative if deferred revenue dynamics weaken.

valuation_summary: DCF build uses GAAP operating income as EBIT, with D&A and capex tied to FY25 cash flow drivers and held as disciplined % of revenue in the base case. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))

Terminal value is computed with a Gordon growth framework using conservative perpetual growth (2.5%) given F5’s mature enterprise infrastructure positioning. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1048695/000104869525000157/ffiv-20250930.htm))
Comp set is provided for triangulation; EV/NTM revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA were not consistently available from accessible sources in this run (values left null).
